user_stories.title: Document CodexModel usage in README
acceptance_criteria: README.md has new 'Executor Models' section after 'Per-phase executors'
Section explains that CodexModel only applies when Codex is the executor
Section describes relationship to executor_policy (codex-first, codex-only, claude-only)
Section explains when field is ignored (claude-only policy)
Documentation is accurate and easy to understand
No breaking changes to existing README content
user_stories.notes: Add clear documentation to help users understand when and why CodexModel applies. This addresses the core confusion without code changes.

user_stories.title: Improve TUI field label with context
acceptance_criteria: TUI input label changed from 'Codex model' to 'Codex model (when Codex executor)'
Label fits within TUI layout without overflow
Field remains editable and functional
Build succeeds without errors
No breaking changes to config schema
user_stories.notes: Update internal/tui/model.go:421 to provide inline context about when the field applies. This is a simple, low-risk change.

user_stories.title: Add visual indication for inactive CodexModel field
acceptance_criteria: CodexModel field appears dimmed when executor_policy is 'claude-only'
Field appears normal when executor_policy is 'codex-first' or 'codex-only'
Field remains visible and readable in all states
Visual change helps users understand when field applies
Build succeeds without errors
No impact on field functionality
user_stories.notes: Add isCodexModelDisabled() helper in model.go and apply dimmed styling in view_settings.go. Optional enhancement - can be deferred if visual clutter is a concern.

user_stories.title: Add warning for inactive CodexModel setting
acceptance_criteria: Warning appears when CodexModel is set to non-default value but executor_policy is 'claude-only'
Warning is clear and non-intrusive
Warning disappears when executor_policy changes to allow Codex
No false positives (warning only shows when appropriate)
Build succeeds without errors
user_stories.notes: Add getCodexModelWarning() helper and integrate with status message display. Optional enhancement - carefully consider if this adds value or creates UI clutter.
